data.one_liner: A high‑powered Dart HTTP server framework with DI, routing and extensible plugins.
data.what_it_does: Provides a minimal core for building server‑side applications, offering dependency injection, sophisticated routing, middleware, and optional features like authentication, ORM, and GraphQL via plugins. It runs on the Dart VM and can be compiled AOT without mirrors.
use_when: You need a full‑stack Dart backend with customizable plugins
You want DI and flexible routing on the server side
You prefer a framework that can be AOT‑compiled for production
avoid_when: You are building only a Flutter client app
You need a lightweight client‑side HTTP client rather than a server
strengths: Supports DI and advanced routing out of the box
Works with AOT compilation and without dart:mirrors
weaknesses: Primarily server‑side, not useful for Flutter UI code
Learning curve due to many optional plugins
Documentation focuses on server use cases
data.setup_notes: Add angel3_framework to pubspec, optionally add angel3_cli for project scaffolding; no native permissions required

alternatives.name: shelf_router
alternatives.why_pick_it: A lightweight router for the Shelf server ecosystem, easier to integrate if you already use Shelf
